# Tab-separated: class, name, source, start (s), seconds.

#   Metal, Pop, Hip-Hop, R&B, Electronic, Jazz, Classical, Blues, Reggae,
#   Acoustic, Game). Game clips are reported but not scored.
# - source: a URL, or a search (the first YouTube hit). Pin a URL once a
#   search lands on the wrong video; <name>.source.txt says what it got.
# - Music clips skip the intro. "Music" is music with no genre class of
#   its own: it shows how often a genre is forced on it.
